title: Mouse voice
author: Yosef Ben Melamed
changes: Trimmed to 3.25–4.10 s of the original, mixed to mono, gentle 12 dB/oct high-pass at 400 Hz, silence trimmed, loudness-normalised (≈ −18 dBFS RMS, peak ≤ −1 dBFS), 10 ms fade-in / 120 ms fade-out, encoded as 96 kbps mono MP3. The high-pass is set to 400 Hz because the original has strong room rumble below the squeak; the natural room tone after the squeak is kept.
